reason: B is better because it provides traceable prior evidence, a quantitative advantage over the analytical baseline (at least 30% error reduction), explicit temperature and phase/composition limits, and a comparatively decisive falsification rule across both regimes. Both proposals remain mechanistically incomplete because an MLIP does not itself predict electronic scattering and neither clearly defines a genuinely held-out conductivity dataset, but A is additionally unsupported by supplied citations and uses a looser absolute-error benchmark.
